features.name: Gauge Needle Sweep (Staging / Celebration)
features.description: Sweeps speedometer and tachometer needles from min to max and back upon ignition activation.
features.prerequisites: Supported instrument cluster revision (Analog & Active Info Display).

features.name: Lap Timer & Oil Temperature Menu
features.description: Activates the track lap timer and dedicated engine oil temperature telemetry screen in cluster MFA.
features.prerequisites: Colour multifunction display or fully digital instrument cluster.

features.name: Refuel Volume Display (Quantity to Add)
features.description: Displays the exact liters/gallons needed to fill fuel tank to capacity in 5-liter increments.

features.name: Seatbelt Acoustic Warning Chime
features.description: Sounds audible chime when driver or passenger seatbelts are unbuckled with vehicle in motion.
